Specification: This module is a regression-style test specification for operators provided by an extended functions library, especially predicates and transformers over functions such as RestrictDomain, RestrictValues, IsInjective, FoldFunction, FoldFunctionOnSet, AntiFunction, Pointwise, and IsRestriction. It uses a large collection of ASSUME statements to check expected values, error behavior, and equivalence to pure logical definitions written directly in TLA+, including tests over records, sequences, ordinary functions, and finite function encodings built with :> and @@. The spec does not model a transition system or fault-tolerant protocol; instead it validates functional behavior and side-effect freedom of library operators, including CHOOSE-based inverse constructions and recursively defined function values.
AssumptionNames: LET T == INSTANCE TLC IN T!PrintT("FunctionsTests")
AssertError("The argument of IsInjective should be a function, but instead it is:\n{}", IsInjective({}))

LET IsInjectivePure(f) == \A a,b \in DOMAIN f : f[a] = f[b] => a = b \* Pure as in no Java module override.
    IN /\ \A f \in [{0,1,2} -> {0,1,2,3}] : IsInjectivePure(f) = IsInjective(f)
       /\ \A f \in [{"a","b","c"} -> {0,1,2,3}] : IsInjectivePure(f) = IsInjective(f)
       /\ \A f \in [{0,1,2,3} -> {"a","b","c"}] : IsInjectivePure(f) = IsInjective(f)

AssertError(
           "The third argument of FoldFunction should be a function, but instead it is:\nTRUE",
           FoldFunction(+, 23, TRUE))

AssertError(
           "The fourth argument of FoldFunctionOnSet should be a set, but instead it is:\nTRUE",
           FoldFunctionOnSet(+, 23, <<>>, TRUE))

AssertError(
           "The third argument of FoldFunctionOnSet should be a function, but instead it is:\nTRUE",
           FoldFunctionOnSet(+, 23, TRUE, {}))

LET InversePure(f, S, T) == [t \in T |-> CHOOSE s \in S : t \in Range(f) => f[s] = t] \* "Pure" as in no Java module override.
    IN /\ \A f \in [{0,1,2} -> {0,1,2,3}] : IsInjective(f) => InversePure(f, DOMAIN f, Range(f)) = AntiFunction(f)
       /\ \A f \in [{"a","b","c"} -> {0,1,2,3}] : IsInjective(f) => InversePure(f, DOMAIN f, Range(f)) = AntiFunction(f)
       /\ \A f \in [{0,1,2,3} -> {"a","b","c"}] : IsInjective(f) => InversePure(f, DOMAIN f, Range(f)) = AntiFunction(f)

LET F == [n1 |-> 0, n2 |-> 2, n3 |-> 1]
	IN AntiFunction(AntiFunction(F)) = F
FunctionConstructor: [t \in T |-> CHOOSE s \in S : t \in Range(f) => f[s] = t]
ChoiceExpr: CHOOSE s \in S : t \in Range(f) => f[s] = t
